title: Lab · Host
description: One BMC, read by poller.py exporter: its firmware and what Redfish can update, the health of every component, and every reading by where it lives in the Redfish tree, with its unit and thresholds.

panels.title: Equipment

targets.expr: redfish_host_info{site="$site",host="$host"}

panels.description: The inventory's vendor and project, the BMC's Manufacturer and Model (- until it answers)

targets.expr: max(redfish_up{site="$site",host="$host"})

panels.title: Worst health

targets.expr: max(redfish_health{site="$site",host="$host"})

panels.description: The worst Status.Health of any of its components

targets.expr: count(redfish_health{site="$site",host="$host"} > 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Readings past a threshold

targets.expr: max(redfish_reading_crossed{site="$site",host="$host"})

panels.description: The furthest any reading is past its thresholds, upper or lower

panels.title: BMC uptime

targets.expr: min(time() - redfish_manager_last_reset_timestamp_seconds{site="$site",host="$host"})

panels.description: Since its last reset (Manager.LastResetTime)

panels.title: Crawl

targets.expr: max(redfish_crawl_seconds{site="$site",host="$host"})

panels.description: How long its last read took, and how many resources it has

panels.title: Firmware inventory

targets.expr: redfish_firmware_info{site="$site",host="$host"}

panels.description: What the BMC reports as firmware: the firmware inventory (UpdateService.FirmwareInventory), the System's BIOS, the Manager's own firmware and the parts' (drives, controllers, NICs, PSUs). Whether Redfish can update each (Updateable, WriteProtected) and how an image gets in: push to MultipartHttpPushUri, or pull with SimpleUpdate, against its Targets and TransferProtocol AllowableValues. The same checks as rollout.py plan.

panels.title: Health of every component

targets.expr: redfish_health{site="$site",host="$host"}

panels.description: Every object with a Status, as the BMC reports it: resources and the objects inside them (each fan, power supply, sensor). Worst first; - is not reported.

panels.title: $thermal_kind

targets.expr: redfish_reading{site="$site",host="$host",resource=~"/redfish/v1/Chassis/.*",kind!~"Power|Voltage|Current|Energy.*|Frequency|ChargeAh",kind="$thermal_kind"}

panels.description: Temperatures, fans and the chassis' other environment readings (Thermal, ThermalSubsystem, Sensors). Each reading's unit comes from the BMC's MetricDefinition, else the DMTF schema of the resource, else its ReadingUnits.
